assertions.name: c2_pivot_matches_c4_truncation_reexam_witness
assertions.source: Route A: C/u² recomputed here at 60 dps from M_K_PM/M_PI_PM, q₀, χ₅ = q⁵−q⁻⁵ and (9/5)². Route B: the `C_over_u_squared` field of the committed meson-habiro-c4-truncation-reexam witness, produced by a different script on a different run.

assertions.name: b_squared_skein_and_hoefsmit_routes_agree
assertions.source: Route A: the skein form (h²+3)/(h²+4) with h = q − 1/q, as used to build u = b·ℏ_q². Route B: the Hoefsmit seminormal 2-dim block, 1 + d₁d₂ with d₁ = q³/(q²+1) and d₂ = −1/(q(q²+1)) — a representation-matrix route that never forms h.

assertions.name: q_bracket_five_matches_su2q_fusion_recursion
assertions.source: Route A: [5]_q = (q⁵ − q⁻⁵)/(q − q⁻¹), the closed form the 24-element substrate basis is built from. Route B: the SU(2)_q fusion recursion [k+1] = [2]_q[k] − [k−1] from [0]=0, [1]=1, iterated to k=5 — no division anywhere.

assertions.name: candidate_scan_finds_no_epsilon_within_half_percent
assertions.source: The NULL verdict's own claim, asserted: of the 15 hand-curated ε candidates scanned at 60 dps, the number landing within 0.5% of the measured ε. Route A: the measured ε = (C/u²/4 − 1)/h² from CODATA meson masses. Route B: 15 substrate quantities built from G, π, q₀, h, ℏ_q, b and q-brackets, none of which sees a meson mass.

description: Task 2 of PR #1617: tests whether meson Habiro c_2 is exactly 4 or slightly off-integer with a structural h² correction (c_2 = 4·(1 + ε·h²)). Pairwise PSLQ across 24 substrate basis elements + 15 hand-curated ε candidates.

data.verdict: NULL — neither PSLQ over 24 substrate basis elements nor hand-curated candidate scan over 15 plausible ε values finds a clean match. ε = -0.03483481008 appears to NOT be a natural substrate quantity. The c_2-off-integer pivot does NOT rescue the meson Habiro c=4 reopening — both framings (c_2=4+c_3 at step 1, c_2=4·(1+ε·h²) here) fail PSLQ at the substrate basis.

caveats: This module's docstring says 'The meson Habiro re-exam found C/u² = 4.00606 (0.15% off integer 4)'. The measured value — here and in the c4-truncation-reexam witness alike — is 3.99391001011, i.e. 0.152% BELOW 4, not above it. Only the magnitude of the docstring figure is right; its sign is inverted. Nothing downstream depends on the docstring, so the numbers in this witness are unaffected, but a reader taking c_2 > 4 from the prose would read ε's sign backwards.
